title: Progress Software Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Progress Software Corporation's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
BURLINGTON, Mass., Sept. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Progress Software](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=2XEAdK9_rniW2S3cfqlyYmUL3LAqPUCKpLsx_hTPU-7er18lQsqZeU0dr185V0Dc6WzlLZ8H4R_JySDb_7BfnALSl3iKnyLYU-rtZuvO8Nw=) (Nasdaq: PRGS), a member of the Russell 2000 Index and an AI infrastructure software leader, today announced its financial results for the fiscal third quarter ended on August 31, 2026.


The company’s earnings release and a supplemental slide presentation can be accessed via the Investor Events & Presentations[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=vPw0Id0FB-XHMiCYid77q8N2QX4-CrOYjEsgJIXbht9MICJWYlXcp9QDNZZyJu7eiAd2NdpGembQOHFp0csr_l7uHWPjRhp30jBh2VnFnSddDmvSGGSxCnIqEVW4nAvq) on the[Progress Investor Relations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=2XEAdK9_rniW2S3cfqlyYpNtvYrOfciCIvRKc2c0CKgiulsiL5m4uMn74q14KzYbQ1xq9TeIEchdMHlPhNxEy8qk4x6w6mMxKQwqhTP7dx8EsMh8AvRcU37re2f8VJGH) webpage. Progress will host a conference call today at 5:00 p.m. ET to discuss its results and outlook.


**Conference Call Details**


- A live webcast of the call will be available[at this link](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/2rbf924z/) .
- To access the conference call by phone, use[this link](https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI8bdfec1cb044440bb00b3b72afef1db1) to retrieve dial-in details. Participants are encouraged to dial in 15 minutes before the scheduled start time.
- A replay of the conference call and supporting materials will be available on the Progress Investor Relations webpage following the live event.


**About Progress Software**
Progress Software (Nasdaq: PRGS) provides the context and control organizations need to reliably extract value from AI— ***context*** drawn from an organization's data, content and workflows, and ***control*** over the security, governance and cost of their AI initiatives. Learn how hundreds of thousands of businesses, powering the work of tens of millions of professionals worldwide, realize value from trusted, enterprise-ready AI at[www.progress.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=6ME3PD9ML_leWw9pLPwkG9xAyVaZNs7Sz4aGQegwhiZBEa1avjxAwyPQ_3w-KtS1Gz4bDMxXm36fo2jnTBBNiqK3-AwUgd3GoFTIVcLFaY0=) .
